subject: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Hollis <kate@brightpath.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement

Hi Kate —

Great to meet you on last week’s partner call. As discussed, we’d like to pilot a “Solution Ambassador Fieldwork” program with BrightPath to accelerate your consultants’ ability to architect and deliver Redwood-based integrations to end customers. High-level objective: enable two BrightPath consultants to be fully self-sufficient on Redwood deployment patterns, inference cost tuning, and runbook creation within 6 weeks.

Proposed scope (short):
- Week 0: access + sandbox + account prep (Redwood account & quota, KMS dev keys)
- Week 1–2: instructor-led 2-day workshop (architecture patterns, runtime ops, caching/batching best practices)
- Week 3: paired lab + POC guidance (customer scenario + small POC delivery)
- Week 4–6: shadow retainer + handoff artifacts (runbooks, playbooks, code samples)

Deliverables we’ll provide: a 60-slide enablement deck, a starter SOW template, hands-on lab environment, and a set of evaluation prompts for regression testing. I attached the enablement-deck-v1.pdf and a first-pass SOW-draft-BP.docx for your team to review.

Questions for you:
1) Do you have two consultants in mind and their desired start week?
2) Any compliance or customer constraints (e.g., strict on-prem only) we should plan for?
3) Preferred workshop timezone (we can run US-PST blocks or split sessions).

If this looks good I’ll loop in Marcus (partner ops) to propose T&Cs and Vanessa for pricing options. Would next Thursday or the following Monday work to schedule the kickoff planning call?

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Kate Hollis <kate@brightpath.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Sanders <tsanders@partnerco.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement

Diego —

Thanks for the clear plan. This is exactly what we need to get our SI teams comfortable delivering Redwood integrations. I can confirm two consultants: Priya N. and Marcus L. (both senior consultants). Tentatively they could start the week of Jan 11th.

A couple of constraints to call out up front:
- One of our target customers will require data to stay in their VPC; we’ll need guidance on on-prem / VPC deploys and KMS options.
- We also have to run an initial security questionnaire; Tom (copied) will lead that.

Next Thursday (Dec 16) morning PST works for a kickoff planning call for us. Please send an invite and any pre-read.

Best,
Kate Hollis
Head of Solutions | BrightPath Consulting
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Hollis <kate@brightpath.com>, Tom Sanders <tsanders@partnerco.io>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement

Team —

Kate confirmed two consultants and a tentative Jan 11 start. She also flagged a need for VPC/on-prem guidance and a security questionnaire. Action items: 

Vanessa: can you draft a price band and a brief MSA clause for private/VPC deploys? We should propose a short pilot SOW (4–6 weeks scope) and an optional shadow retainer. I attached a link to the draft SOW in Drive.

Laura: can you pull together the enablement agenda and identify the hands-on labs we’ll run (ideal: one inference perf lab, one deployment lab, and one eval/regression lab)?

Marcus: please help coordinate commercial hooks and decide if we need a trial credit offer for the POC stage.

Kate/Tom: for the security questionnaire, if you can share the form ahead of Dec 16 I’ll loop in security to respond.

I’ll schedule Dec 16 10:00 PST for a 45-minute planning call and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Diego
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Hollis <kate@brightpath.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:48:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement

Diego / all —

Attached (enablement-deck-v1.pdf) is the current deck. I also uploaded a pricing matrix to the Drive folder and started a pilot SOW draft (SOW-draft-BP.docx) that aligns to a 6-week pilot: fixed fee for the workshop + time-and-materials for shadow retainer (up to 40 hours). Quick notes:
- Pilot price estimate: $38k–$52k depending on level of shadow support and whether we provide sandbox infra credits.
- VPC/on-prem support: additional professional services line item; we will require a DPA + support SLA for on-prem installs (see clause in SOW).

I’ll be on the Dec 16 call and can present pricing variations. Marcus — we should decide whether to include a 2-week free sandbox credit to reduce friction for the POC.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Hollis <kate@brightpath.com>, Tom Sanders <tsanders@partnerco.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:34:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Solution Ambassador Fieldwork: BrightPath onboarding & enablement

All —

Thanks for the updates. I’ve penciled in the Dec 16 10:00 PST call and added a short agenda item for commercial terms and trial credit decision (5–10 minutes).

Decision: I’m comfortable offering a 2-week sandbox credit for the POC; include it as an option in the SOW with the higher price band if they want Redwood-managed sandbox infra. Vanessa, please surface the exact credit mechanics.

Diego — after the call, let’s capture the mutual action plan (owner + dates) and drop it in HS-89023 so Sales has visibility.

—Marcus
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
